summary: The pending INR 2,150,000.00 payment from Orchid Pharma Asia Pte Ltd to Hyderabad Organics Private Limited faces potential delays and rejections due to strict cut-off times at Golconda Commercial Bank, beneficiary name discrepancies, and missing RBI purpose codes.

warnings.title: Missed Cut-off Time
warnings.detail: The payment must be submitted before the 12:00 IST (14:30 SGT) cut-off at Golconda Commercial Bank to avoid next-day credit. The planned submission at 15:10 SGT will trigger a delay.
warnings.fix: Reschedule the submission to before 14:30 SGT.

warnings.title: Beneficiary Name Mismatch
warnings.detail: Past rejections for this client involved legal suffix discrepancies, as clearing entities maintain a strict policy of rejecting payments that do not feature the precise legal suffix of the beneficiary.
warnings.fix: Ensure the beneficiary name exactly matches the registered legal name of Hyderabad Organics Private Limited.

warnings.title: Missing Purpose Code
warnings.detail: Missing RBI purpose codes have caused rejections for INR payments routed through the intermediary.
warnings.fix: Ensure the RBI purpose code is explicitly included in the payment instruction.

evidence.text: Payment exception EXC-260910-02 for Vantage Analytics Pte Ltd involving an INR 2,594,000.00 transfer to Srinivasa Infotech Private Limited at Golconda Commercial Bank was rejected on 2026-09-10 due to a missing RBI purpose code.

Payment exception EXC-260923-01 for INR 1,390,000.00 from Vantage Analytics Pte Ltd to Mysuru Software Services Pvt Ltd at Tungabhadra Co-operative Bank was rejected on 2026-09-23 due to a beneficiary name mismatch.
Payment exception EXC-260828-01 occurred on 2026-08-28 due to a NOSTRO_FUNDING_SHORTFALL in the IDR nostro account at Nusantara Sentral Bank, which was caused by month-end outflows.
Payment EXC-260911-01 was resolved by amending the beneficiary name to 'DECCAN BIO LABS PRIVATE LIMITED' and requesting the client to update their beneficiary master data.
Payment exception EXC-260826-02 was returned by MBSB with reason code AC04 (Closed account number).
Payment exception EXC-260831-02 was resolved by a Treasury top-up requested at 11:30 SGT and released at 14:05 SGT on 2026-08-31.
Orchid Pharma Asia Pte Ltd submitted an INR 1,975,000.00 payment to Hyderabad Organics Private Limited on 2026-08-26 via Coromandel Clearing Bank to Golconda Commercial Bank.
Orchid Pharma Asia Pte Ltd submitted an INR 1,918,000.00 payment to Hyderabad Organics Private Limited on 2026-09-10 via Coromandel Clearing Bank to Golconda Commercial Bank.

directives.name: Sanctions holds are human-only
directives.content: Never recommend releasing, auto-approving or bypassing a payment held by sanctions screening, even if the beneficiary was cleared before. Always route sanctions hits to the Compliance team for human review; a prior clearance reference may be cited only as supporting context.

directives.name: Mask account numbers
directives.content: Never write a full bank account number or IBAN in an answer. Show only the last 4 characters, e.g. ****0913.

directives.name: Cite evidence
directives.content: When you state a pattern, cite the dates or case IDs of the past exceptions it is based on. If memory has no relevant evidence, say so explicitly instead of guessing.
